# `DCR_GIT_BRANCH_MISMATCH`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | error |
| Area | [Design change requests (`DCR_`)](README.md#domain-dcr) |
| Reported by | `cli` |

## What happened

The request's branch differs from the CLI's current git branch.

## What to do

Run `git switch <branch>`, then retry. Or download the request.
